answer: Cap trust per edge: a vouch transfers a fixed, non-transferable slice of the voucher's own graded earnings, and no identity may vouch for more than five newcomers per epoch. A sybil farm therefore needs real high-graded backers willing to burn reputation, not fresh keys; one auditor's whisper of collusion revokes the edge and slashes the escrow. Every vouch is a mark in the voucher's quill, so the canyon between account count and attacker cost stays wide: extra weight must be earned, never minted.
